values.note: $12 a night per site, paid on site at the self-pay station (recreation.gov Scan and Pay).

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/allegheny/recreation/minister-creek-campground ('Single Site: $12 per night', page last updated 2026-04-08) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165465/rates (First-come, First-served Season 2026: $12), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 'No reservations are accepted. This campground is a first come, first served site.' Arrive in person and pay at the self-pay station; stays limited to 14 consecutive days in a 30-day window.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/allegheny/recreation/minister-creek-campground (Reservations) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165465 (Overview: first-come first-served only, 14 consecutive days within a 30 day window), read 2026-10-20

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/allegheny/recreation/minister-creek-campground ('six family campsites') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165465 ('There are 6 sites available'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Drinking water from a hand pump.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/allegheny/recreation/minister-creek-campground ('Vault toilet(s)', 'Potable water is available at this site. Drinking water is available from a hand pump.'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed $12/night, FCFS-only (not reservable), 6 sites; added the 14-night limit, season 3/31-10/31, vault toilets and hand-pump water. Not stated on official pages: hookups (no-hookup values stay derived from the note) and any site length; the note's 'tents and small RVs only' has no official source (the only length figure found is a 2018 Campendium user report of a 34-ft travel trailer).
